commits.subject: Centralize transcript overlay input routing (#62384)
commits.reason: Use the upstream overlay accessor to route transcript search, selection and runtime key bindings. The fork’s findings view remains a static pager with its own navigation and policy dismissal.
evidence: All five changed files move the existing transcript-only input checks behind Overlay::input_transcript and Overlay::set_keymap_bindings. Search retains the editor context, selection retains the transcript-select context and the backtrack preview keeps browsing priority over the ordinary pager context.

The fork’s MisalignmentReview variant wraps StaticOverlay. Opening findings copies the current pager keymap. Its close, scroll and opt-out paths operate on that pager. Analytics and ordinary static pages also have independent handlers. Only Transcript contains the shared live transcript view.

The changes merge cleanly over the fork’s #400 source. Its retained transcript capture and restore still use the actual TranscriptOverlay, while the new routing methods leave the retained representation and live history insertion unchanged.

Three native controls passed on the retained fork predecessor 439cc0e40b: a conflicting F4 selects pager motion, F3 enters search and the draft survives exit; an editor chord belongs to the open search; opting out dismisses the findings pager. The five-file integrated patch on c3b82af824 has the same stable patch ID as upstream, 979def7b552d586d5b259e19cc54fce127d33385.
commits.revisit: Exercise the same normal application input routes on the combined source and recheck ownership when a future overlay embeds a selectable transcript.
